messages:
maria: Quick async check-in — what I did / blockers / today

maria: did a capacity scrub across regions. Headroom snapshot: AMS ~18%, US-W ~22%, APAC (ap-southeast-1) ~5%.
Blocker: quota request for ap-southeast-1 still pending (CL-5421).
Today: plan to queue a targeted prewarm and coordinate a short spot-fallback window if we don't get quota in time.

sam: thanks — quick question: can we enable spot fallback while preserving latency for small models? :thinking_face:
I can flip the routing policy if ops OK it.

josh: prefer we degrade to smaller model variants first, then spot. don't want large-model requests evicted mid-inference.
Suggest policy order: small -> medium -> spot-large.

anya: fyi, dedicated non-prod pool had a big eval run last night, bumped utilization by ~30% between 02:00-03:00 UTC.
I've tagged heavy-eval jobs with `no-preempt` off for next 24h to avoid surprises.

deploybot: DeployBot: prewarm job queued: `prewarm-apac-2310` -> queued (id: pw-4827) :white_check_mark:

sam: prepping the flip command and a rollback plan now. Proposed command:
```
./infractl set-fallback --region ap-southeast-1 \
  --policy "model-size,spot" \
  --model-order small,medium,large
```
Rollback: `./infractl unset-fallback --region ap-southeast-1`
I'll run in the approved change window only.

josh: tagging @ops for approval. Also add an automatic revert after 2h to be safe.

ops: Approved for a 2h window starting when the prewarm job hits the queue. Watch 95p latency and token cost delta.

anya: I'll throttle non-prod evals during the window and monitor the model fallback metrics.

maria: sweet — final plan:
- Hold prewarm until 23:10 APAC (to let quota request arrive)
- If quota not granted, sam flips fallback with the command above
- ops watches latency; auto-revert after 2h
- anya throttles evals and monitors spend
I'll update runbook + ticket: https://redwood/jira/CL-5421
Please ack when you see this. :+1:

sam: acked, standing by.

josh: acked.

anya: acked and started throttle.

ops: watching.
